SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 21, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 876 4650 1922
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87646501922
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 876 4650 1922
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.
1.
Call to Order
COVID-19 Protocols for In-Person Meetings
Full Meeting PowerPoint Presentation
2.
Invocation
The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution.
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Annual Reorganization of the City Council and Successor Agency (Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair)
Public Comments
Special Meeting public comments are limited to items listed on the agenda. Public comments will be taken after the initial staff presentation on this item. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
6.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND
THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 21, 2021, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL
CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 876 4650 1922

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Jeff Ludington, Generations Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Public Works Department and Recreation Services
  Division staff.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to excuse Mayor Pro Tem/Vice
  Chair Chuong Vo from the meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

5.  Annual Reorganization of the City Council and Successor Agency (Selection of
  Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair)

  Mayor Solanki welcomed the community to the Annual Reorganization meeting. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  Council/Agency Members introduced their family and special guests in attendance.

  Public comments

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Daisy Legasca inquired as to Councilmember Yokoyama’s attendance at the Council/Agency
  meetings.

  Jay Gray spoke regarding the lack of public participation at the Charter Review Study Sessions
  and suggested Council actions may be obstacles to increased public participation. He requested
  the formation of a citizen advisory commission, composed of fifteen members, three appointed
  by each Councilmember, focused on ideas for increasing public participation in meetings.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 21, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 2 of 4

5.  (continued)

  Leah Nass thanked Mayor Solanki, Mayor Pro Tem Vo, and the Councilmembers for their service
  to the community and their efforts to navigate the issues related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

  Los Angeles County Fourth District Supervisor Janice Hahn thanked Mayor Solanki for his two
  terms of service as Mayor of Cerritos and acknowledged his many accomplishments, particularly
  those efforts related to leading the City during the COVID-19 pandemic.

  Mayor Solanki noted the attendance of Lynda Johnson, Field Deputy for Los Angeles County
  Fourth District Supervisor Janice Hahn.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  Recognition of Mayor Naresh Solanki’s Mayoral Terms

  Mayor Solanki reflected upon his Mayoral Term, noted the many achievements, and expressed
  his thanks to his family, friends, colleagues, the Cerritos community, and City staff.

  Mayor Solanki made a presentation to his wife and thanked her for her love and support during
  his Mayoral terms.

  Additional dignitaries and members of the public recognized Mayor Solanki, verbally and
  through the submission of proclamations and certificates, on his accomplishments during the
  Mayoral term, as listed below:

  Misty Coda, Field Representative, 32nd District State Senator Bob Archuleta.

  Viviana Gomez, Field Representative, 58th District Assemblymember Cristina Garcia.

  Lynda Johnson, Field Representative, Los Angeles County Fourth District Supervisor Janice
  Hahn.

  Los Angeles County Sheriff Alex Villanueva and the entire Los Angeles County Sheriff’s
  Department.

  Cerritos Sheriff’s Captain Minh Dinh, representing the personnel of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station.

  Rene Trevino, Mayor of the City of Artesia.

  Luis Roya, Mayor of the City of Hawaiian Gardens.

  Mayor Jeff Wood and the entire City Council of the City of Lakewood.

  Sophia Tse, President, ABC Unified School District Board of Education.

  Dr. Mary Sieu, ABC Unified School District Superintendent.

  Ernie Nishii, ABC Unified School District Board of Education Member.

  Brad Beach, ABC Unified School District Board of Education Member.

  Laura Sanchez-Ramirez, President, and Tracy McSparren, Superintendent, Bellflower Unified
  School District Board of Education.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 21, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 3 of 4

5.  (continued)

  Desmond Thompson, Chairman of the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce.

  Mark Dameron, President of the Cerritos Republican Club.

  Kirit Chihuan, community member.

  Daisy Legasca, community member.

  Mayor Solanki thanked members of the City staff for their service.

  Council/Agency Member Barrows led the City Council’s presentations to Mayor Naresh Solanki
  on his Mayoral Terms. Council/Agency Member Hu and Council/Agency Member Barrows offered
  comments on Mayor Solanki’s Mayoral Terms.

  The Council/Agency Members presented outgoing Mayor Naresh Solanki with official plaques
  and City scrapbooks memorializing his 2019-20 and 2020-21 Mayoral Terms.

  Council/Agency Member Barrows introduced a video highlighting Mayor Naresh Solanki’s
  Mayoral Terms.

  Annual Reorganization Proceedings

  Mayor Solanki directed Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, to conduct the Annual
  Reorganization Proceedings. A brief recorded video from Mayor Pro Tem Vo was displayed.

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and
  called for nominations from the floor. A second is not required for nominations.

  Council/Agency Member Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Hu for the Office of
  Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared
  the nomination period closed.

  As nominated by Council/Agency Member Solanki, Council/Agency Member Hu was confirmed
  by the following roll call vote (4 – 0) to the Office of Mayor/Chair by acclamation:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair
  vacant and called for nominations from the floor. A second is not required for nominations.

  Council/Agency Member Barrows nominated Council/Agency Member Vo for the Office of Mayor
  Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared
  the nomination period closed.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 21, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 4 of 4

5.  (continued)

  As nominated by Council/Agency Member Barrows, Council/Agency Member Vo was confirmed
  by the following roll call vote (3 – 1) to the Office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by acclamation:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Solanki
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, called for a brief meeting recess.

  Mayor Hu reconvened the meeting.

  A ceremonial roll call of the reorganized City Council/Successor Agency was conducted as
  follows:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Vo (excused absence by Council/Agency action earlier in
  meeting)
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

  Brief closing comments were provided by Council/Agency Members Barrows, Solanki, and
  Yokoyama and Mayor/Chair Hu.

6.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:30 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
